大きい面を再サンプルしてまとめ直すのではなく、Cの実部品分割から把持・支持に必要: The new partition starts from C's actual parts, with bounded grip/support changes, rather than repainting a fresh large-area sample. Facial colors belong to whole physical parts.
4.8mmは新しい半高ファミリー（屋根1.6mm・下面空間3.2mm）。8mmピ: 4.8mm is an explicit new half-height family:1.6mm roof and3.2mm open cavity.8mm pitch,4.8mm-diameter/1.8mm-tall studs and the open-underside interface remain fixed.
露出スタッドの高さは、前案の表面段間隔に対して約56%でした。新案では約38%と: Exposed stud height was about56% of a previous surface course. It is about38% in the refinement, nearer initial C's35%. The comparison therefore checks actual forehead/smile depth, not just color.
実12,435部品、前案から+1,527。初期Cとの差は-1,402で、個数の多: Actual 12,435 pieces; +1,527 vs previous and -1,402 vs C. More pieces alone do not constitute aesthetic approval.
実native小片で目地差を確認し、外側の3,763部品だけに上外周0.20mm: After an actual-native wall probe, a0.20mm upper-perimeter chamfer is applied only to3,763 exterior parts. 8,596 internal half-height parts retain their plain bearing faces. No extra pieces are added; finish variants are real distinct types.
Cを単純に2倍にした弱い旧ピンではありません。そのためCの2倍相当よりスタッド径: This does not double C's weak legacy pins. The retained studs are wider than C studs scaled2x;0.2mm XY seams, seated vertical body contact and visible roofs also differ.
初期Cの体高360mmに基礎6.4mmとスタッドを加え、実高さは368.2mm（: The360mm registered C body plus6.4mm foundation and top studs gives an actual368.2mm height (+8.0mm vs previous). Equal-screen-height images are not physical-size comparisons.
1×1例外は31個。長い把持延長なしの位置/IDを公開し、扱いやすさは未試験です: 31 one-cell exceptions have no extended grip; their positions/IDs are disclosed and handling is untested. Independent minimum dimensions may belong to different parts.
仮支持台2個は本体個数から除外。実保持力・全体荷重/転倒を確認するまで撤去しませ: The2 temporary pedestals are excluded from figure count. Do not remove before actual retention, load and tipping checks.
本人による前案の方向性への肯定は、この新案の最終採用や現物印刷の承認ではありませ: The user's positive direction feedback on the previous pilot does not approve this new candidate or physical printing. No complete plate pack, slicing,G-code or new trial was created.

新案の白い目縁と黒い目の外形、笑口、耳・ひげの段階パターンは、前36cm案より初: White eye rims, dark eye outlines, the smile and stepped ears/whiskers are closer to initial C than in the previous360 pilot. Original-source IoU is not substituted for that appearance target.

面取りで細い明るい縁も出る。初期Cの暗い上下の隙間とは同一ではなく、黒目の面や小: The finish also creates fine bright edges. It is not identical to C's dark open vertical gaps; dark-eye surfaces and the small nose's shadow/contour retain differences. Complete aesthetic equivalence is not claimed.
